biography.plain_text: Michael Huber is a German entrepreneur who built and sold the Interspe Hamann logistics group. After schooling in Dallas and unfinished business studies in Berlin, he established transport companies. He later led the Veltins brewery for nearly three decades and became a substantial shareholder and supervisory board chairman at lighting manufacturer Trilux.

long_biography.plain_text:
While leading Veltins, Michael Huber reversed his refusal to fund a new beer crate during a trip with senior colleagues in Africa. He sketched a possible solution in the sand with a stick, and the group agreed over dinner to introduce the Porsche-designed crate.

At Trilux, he pursued a different response to the shift towards LED lighting: buying components from specialist suppliers and combining them into lighting systems and services. The company worked with Samsung and Philips rather than making its own chips. Huber also doubled the marketing budget and built a technology centre focused on lighting controls.

While leading Veltins, Michael Huber reversed his refusal to fund a new beer crate during a trip with senior colleagues in Africa. He sketched a possible solution in the sand with a stick, and the group agreed over dinner to introduce the Porsche-designed crate.

At Trilux, he pursued a different response to the shift towards LED lighting: buying components from specialist suppliers and combining them into lighting systems and services. The company worked with Samsung and Philips rather than making its own chips. Huber also doubled the marketing budget and built a technology centre focused on lighting controls.
